_doc: Project copy for /resume and /work. Media comes from media/manifest.json (built by ~/.claude/major-distributions/portfolio/build_media.py). Every claim here must be true and checkable: no invented metrics. `personal: true` = own photography, not a client: shown with the work but left out of every brand count.
